groups.name: N0n
groups.profile: Data-extortion crew first seen Sep 2026; RansomLook counts 304 posts all-time, 86 in the last 7 days. Posts numbered "Company #NNN" placeholders before naming victims, and often re-lists names. Today's batch of 10 household-name and SMB retail/finance brands landed at a single timestamp, RansomLook-only. RedPacket Security has cautioned that N0n listings include unverified claims.
groups.sectors: Retail, apparel, consumer electronics, financial services, media

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Most prolific RaaS of 2025–26 (active since Oct 2022); Rust/Go encryptors, ESXi targeting, credential-based initial access. All six were name-only posts in both feeds.

groups.name: PixelLeaks
groups.profile: Leak site first seen 3 Nov 2026. Posts uniform "verified set of records" notices with 3–4-day publication deadlines and platform names in titles. Ransomware.live back-filled 19 of its earlier victims today (all already in №80, №83, №84).

groups.name: Inc Ransom
groups.profile: Double-extortion operation active since mid-2023; exploits edge devices and spear-phishing; heavy on healthcare, education and public sector.

groups.name: LockBit5
groups.profile: LockBit 5.0, the rebuilt LockBit brand after the 2024 Operation Cronos takedown; cross-platform builds (Windows, Linux, ESXi) and renewed hospital targeting in Asia (per DeXpose, Brinztech).
